assumptions.capacity: Unless an explicit per-site source is recorded, max_group_size is a conservative product planning cap of4, not a campground occupancy claim.
assumptions.coordinates: Only Lane Cove has explicit decimal GPS in the checked official visitor page. Other legacy fictional coordinates were removed.
assumptions.dynamic_conditions: Weather, road state and current fire state are simulated inputs, not verified live conditions. Old fictional closures were removed. Check official alerts independently for real travel.
assumptions.prices: Whole-group reference allowances are not operator prices. No booking, ferry fare, availability, traffic or live weather API was queried.
assumptions.seasons: Catalogue supports year-round trip input, subject to date guards and simulated coverage; this is not a booking availability promise.
assumptions.unknowns: Unknown public transport, accessibility, fire permission or potable supply are not converted into false/true. No guaranteed quietness is inferred from quiet hours.
